title: Define alternative route and refusal policies
objective: Narrative pressure cannot force player choice.
decision: A content owner may supply two already admitted routes. The pure narrative selector advances only the route explicitly selected against a current causal checkpoint. An unselected/refused route has no candidate state; an admitted Continue consequence retains an open thread. Session is the only durable commit owner.

alternatives_considered.option: Advance a preferred route when the player refuses
alternatives_considered.reason: Would turn narrative salience into a player action and violate the choice boundary.

alternatives_considered.option: Invent a substitute delivery or fact during selection
alternatives_considered.reason: The existing API accepts authored admitted alternatives and already accepted source facts only.

alternatives_considered.option: Leave the beat pending or select an authored route with an exact accepted source
alternatives_considered.reason: Matches the registered public df-narrative operations and governing narrative design.

assertion_inventory: Unselected refusal returns Selection error; checkpoint, active/completed beat, character choices, resources, facts and decisions are unchanged.
Each of two selected authored routes stages only its own beat transition; accepted source fact, open thread, all sibling state, basis and pins stay equal.
Repeated route, duplicate ambiguous selection, unknown source, stale basis, stale policy and orphan unaccepted source all refuse without mutating the current checkpoint.
Missing accepted understanding, absent required thread, revoked audience and event-definition mismatch refuse without inventing access or applying a route.
Admitted Continue consequence keeps the thread open and carries exact source evidence; repeat and unknown source refuse.

unsupported_or_pending: This contract does not prove a campaign authoring schema, complete campaign alternatives, calibrated agency, or refusal UI.
The existing native journey Session tests cover real DurableOwner with a controlled repository port; this utility does not claim physical PostgreSQL evidence.
Source code and fixture must be compiled and executed from a frozen admitted candidate before any acceptance claim.
